description: The chart illustrates estimated “effect” values (with uncertainty shown by vertical error bars) for four morphosyntactic tag categories—case, gender, number, and tense—measured across six model/setting combinations listed in the legend. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable labeled “tag,” with categories ordered left to right as case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 (the plotted range extends slightly below 0 and above 20 to accommodate error bars). For each tag category, there is a grouped set of six bars arranged side-by-side, corresponding to mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). In the case group, the bars are approximately ~6 (mBERT-L₂), ~5–6 (XLM-L₂), ~3 (mBERT-R₂), ~2 (XLM-R₂), ~12–13 (mBERT-B₂), and ~11–12 (XLM-B₂), each with relatively large error bars extending several units. In the gender group, the bars are smaller, around ~1–2 (mBERT-L₂), ~0–1 (XLM-L₂), ~2 (mBERT-R₂), ~1 (XLM-R₂), ~4–5 (mBERT-B₂), and ~3–4 (XLM-B₂), again with visible error bars. In the number group, the first four bars are near ~1 (light blue and dark blue) and ~0.5–1 (light green and dark green), while the pink and red bars are around ~2–3, with moderate error bars. In the tense group, all six bars are close to zero (roughly between ~0 and ~1), with small-to-moderate error bars; no bars appear specially highlighted beyond their distinct colors, and the groups are not visually sorted by bar height within each category.
